attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on December 11, 2026
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited has issued a notice for its First Extra-Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for December 11, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST. The meeting will consider two special business items. Item one proposes the preferential issue of up to 5,14,491 convertible warrants to promoter group members Mr. Tummala Madhu Mitra and Mrs. Tummala Pavana Devi. Each warrant is convertible into one equity share of face value Rs. 10 at a price of Rs. 291.55 per warrant. The total aggregation is up to Rs. 14,99,99,851.05. Proceeds will fund working capital and general corporate purposes. Item two proposes an alteration to the objects clause of the Memorandum of Association. Remote e-voting commences on December 08, 2026, and ends on December 10, 2026. The cut-off date for eligibility is December 04, 2026. These resolutions are pending shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Tera Software Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Tera Software Limited has published its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at its meeting held on November 11, 2026. The publication was made in the Financial Express and Nava Telangana newspapers on November 13, 2026. The results are also available on the company website at https://terasoftware.com/quarterly-results. This intimation is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company scrip code is 533982 and the symbol is TERASOFT.
